title: Account Tenure Discount on Payout Methods Conversion Fees
content:
**Term.** The conversion fee charged on a transfer to a host's Payout Methods paid in a currency other than USD carries a long-standing account discount. The conversion fee's long-standing account discount is 15% when the host account's opened date is at least 60 whole months before the settlement day, 8% when it is at least 36 but fewer than 60 whole months before it, and nothing for a newer account.

**Record read.** The opened date on the host's Host Accounts record, the date the host account was opened. The months are whole months from that date to the settlement day, the day the conversion fee falls due (the rail's processing time in business days after the transfer was sent).

## Tenure bands

| Whole months from the host account's opened date to the settlement day | Long-standing account discount |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 15% |
| 36 to 59 | 8% |
| Fewer than 36 | Nothing |

## Lines on both sides (hypothetical settlement day 2026-05-12)

| Host account opened | Whole months | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 2021-05-12 | 60 | 15% |
| 2021-05-13 | 59 | 8% |
| 2023-05-12 | 36 | 8% |
| 2023-05-13 | 35 | Nothing |

## Notes

- The discount follows the age of the host account, whatever the age of the payout method the transfer was sent to.
- A host account opened 4 years and 2 months before the settlement day (50 whole months, hypothetically) carries 8%.
